title: conditional get on page load with no click shows no window and answers nothing

unsafe.definition: a Ferret window opened for a conditional request with no user gesture
an assertion delivered for the conditional request with no click anywhere

note: L3 §5.1.4 (conditional mediation): no modal UI; the promise only settles when the user picks a passkey in autofill, so nothing may answer within holdMs. Page must report "pending" after holdMs.
